run_darts_imagenet: run the DARTS architecture prediction and evaluation script on the ImageNet dataset
run_darts_cifar10: run the DARTS architecture prediction and evaluation script on the CIFAR-10 dataset
create_ghn2_model: create a GHN2 parameter prediction model for a given dataset like imagenet or cifar10
build_darts_network: build a DARTS Network with configurable channels, cells, genotype, and normalization settings
infer_model_accuracy: infer top1 and top5 accuracy of a model on a validation image dataset
